reduceTransparency.title: Reduce Transparency
reduceTransparency.hint: Turns off blur and makes glass opaque; easier on slower phones.

demo.title: Demo Mode
demo.hint: Uses a built-in demo router instead of a real one. Demo changes reset when the app restarts.

notify.title: Notifications & Widget
notify.footer: In the background, the app checks the routers with alerts on about every 15 minutes. The system decides when: on iOS it may be hours apart, and battery saving delays it too. Only routers with a saved password can be watched.
notify.needsPassword: No saved password, so it can't be checked in the background
notify.permissionDenied: RouteLink may not send notifications: allow it in the system settings
notify.offlineBody: The background check could not reach the router: a power cut, no internet, or a restart.
notify.onlineBody: The router can be reached again.
notify.newDeviceBody: {{name}} ({{mac}}) appeared on this router for the first time.

widgets.title: Home Screen Widgets
widgets.intro: Your router's state on the home screen. Tap ↻ on a widget to read the router right away; widgets also update when you open the app, on background checks and about every half hour.
widgets.noPassword: The current router's password is not saved, so widgets cannot read it themselves: ↻ opens the app.
widgets.blockedTitle: No prompt to add the widget?
widgets.blockedBody: Your phone did not let RouteLink add to the home screen. Allow "Home screen shortcuts" (or "Create shortcuts"; on Xiaomi and Redmi under "Other permissions") in RouteLink's app permissions, then tap Add again. You can also long-press an empty spot on the home screen and add it from Widgets.
widgets.manualTitle: Add It from the Home Screen
widgets.manualBody: This launcher can't add widgets from the app. Long-press an empty spot on the home screen, tap Widgets, find RouteLink and drag one onto the home screen.
widgets.footer: Widgets show the router the app opens on. On Xiaomi, vivo, OPPO, Huawei, Honor and similar phones, allow RouteLink to auto-start and run in the background, or widgets may stop updating once the app is closed.
widgets.iosFooter: Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, tap Edit → Add Widget and find RouteLink. It updates when you open the app and on background checks, so it may lag behind.
